annotations.title: Condition of an MCP server before connecting (7Maps)

description: Call before using a server you have not used today. Returns up or down, sign-in need, speed, tool risk counts and last tool change. Reads the map; never calls the server. Charged tool: see list_paid_tools. Example: {"server":"https://mcp.example.com/mcp"}

agent_model.description: Optional: your model id, e.g. "claude-sonnet-5-5". Anonymous

last_trip.description: Optional: how your previous call to a server 7Maps named went

ok.description: Did it do what you needed

surprise.description: Side effect you did not ask for

license_key.description: 7IT plan license key; else pay per call (x402)

server.description: The server URL (https://mcp.example.com/mcp), its official registry name, or npm:<package> / pypi:<package> for a server that runs locally

task_type.description: Optional: kind of work (only the category is kept)
